items.title: Show HN: Codex Reset – A tracker for public Codex reset signals
items.contentSnippet:
I often go to X to check if Codex reset.
So I made this small website.  
It checks public reset news every 5 minutes, and shows the difference of global reset, banked reset and personal reset.  
It cannot check anyone’s personal account.
I am still improving it and want to know what you think.  
https://codexreset.live

items.title: Show HN: What's Next – make Claude Code respond with choice, not prose
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I built `What's Next` (whats-next@kvit) – a Claude Code plugin that makes it respond with a short report + a card of 2-4 options instead of wall of Claude's prose.
Almost like reverse Jev - I just want to select from options, not write sentenses of what to do next.

items.title: Show HN: Yass – Yet Another Spec Syntax Enters Beta
items.contentSnippet:
This has been a side project for a while but it’s finally ready for public Beta.
Tl;dr: Yass leverages RFC2119 keywords in a minimal Yaml format, relying on trained in behaviors for those keywords to provide strong model behaviors.
The yass CLI itself is all that you need - simply tell an Agent to look at the shakefu/yass repo README and they get all the information needed to proceed.
